enterprise.hero_desc: OmniVoice is free for personal, educational, and research use under the Functional Source License (FSL-1.1-ALv2). Each version transitions to Apache 2.0 two years after release. Commercial use — embedding OmniVoice into a paid product, SaaS, or service — requires a commercial license.
enterprise.feature_full_ip_desc: Your voices, your data, your servers. No third-party dependency.
enterprise.feature_zero_cost_desc: Flat licensing. Generate millions of minutes without usage caps.
enterprise.feature_team_access_desc: Share across your org. No per-seat API key management.
enterprise.feature_direct_support_desc: Talk to the engineers who built it, not a helpdesk.
enterprise.feature_source_available_desc: Audit the code. Fork if needed. Apache 2.0 two years after release — no vendor lock-in.
enterprise.feature_languages_desc: Ship global content from one tool. No third-party locale add-ons.
enterprise.pricing_note: Tiers and pricing are still being finalized. Early adopters get founder pricing locked in.
enterprise.faq_internal: Do I need a license for internal tools?
enterprise.faq_internal_answer: No. FSL covers internal use by teams up to a defined revenue cap. If your company's annual revenue exceeds $5M USD, reach out for a license.
enterprise.faq_try_answer: Yes. The full feature set is available for free for non-commercial use. Run it, test it, build your workflow — then license when you go to production.
enterprise.faq_watermark_answer: AudioSeal (Meta) watermark is applied by default for non-commercial use. Licensed users can opt out and ship clean audio.
enterprise.faq_apache: Does the source ever become Apache 2.0?
enterprise.faq_apache_answer: Yes. Every release transitions to Apache 2.0 exactly two years after its release date. The current version is FSL; older releases are Apache 2.0.
enterprise.support_desc: OmniVoice is free, open-source, and runs entirely on your hardware. If it brings value to your workflow, consider supporting the core team.
enterprise.github_sponsors_desc: Recurring or one-time — directly through GitHub.
enterprise.kofi_desc: Buy the team a coffee. No account needed.
enterprise.paypal_desc: Quick one-time or recurring via PayPal.
enterprise.contribution_message: Every contribution helps push the boundaries of local AI.
enterprise.hero_subtitle_p1: OmniVoice Studio is source-available under the
enterprise.hero_subtitle_p2: — free for personal, educational, and non-commercial use, and converts to Apache 2.0 two years after each release. Building a competing product or service on top of OmniVoice?
enterprise.hero_subtitle_cta: Pricing tiers coming soon — get in touch in the meantime.
enterprise.faq_internal_answer_page: Internal use by your employees and contractors is a Permitted Purpose under the FSL — no license required. A commercial license is needed when you make OmniVoice available to others as part of a competing product or service (resale, hosted SaaS, white-label).
enterprise.faq_try_answer_page: Yes. The full app is free to download and run locally for evaluation under the FSL. When you're ready to discuss a commercial deployment, email us and we'll work through the details together.
enterprise.faq_watermark_answer_page: The invisible AudioSeal watermark is embedded by default. Commercial licensees can disable it in Settings → Privacy. Free/personal use always includes the watermark.
enterprise.faq_apache_answer_page: Yes. Each release converts automatically to the Apache License, Version 2.0 on the second anniversary of its publication. That means today's release is Apache 2.0 in two years, no action required from us — the FSL guarantees it irrevocably.
